title: Notoginsenoside R1 as a Protector Against Gentamicin Ototoxicity: Targeting p62-NRF2-GPX4 Ferroptosis Axis.
authors: Chen, Xiaorui; Jiang, Ruoyu; Chu, Yunfeng; Sun, Yan; Yuan, Zijiang; Qian, Yuhan; Cheng, Xiaolan; Dong, Hongjun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究三七皂苷R1通过p62-NRF2-GPX4轴抑制铁死亡保护听力，核心是药物-蛋白互作与细胞氧化应激，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Sudden sensorineural hearing loss (SSNHL) is a common auditory disorder, with oxidative stress and ferroptosis implicated in its pathogenesis. Notoginsenoside R1, a major component of Panax notoginseng, exhibits antioxidant and cytoprotective effects, but its role in ferroptosis regulation remains unclear. In this study, a mouse model of SSNHL and an oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation (OGD/R)-induced Ear Institute-Organ of Corti 1 (HEI-OC1) cell model were used to evaluate the effects of Notoginsenoside R1. Notoginsenoside R1 significantly reduced auditory brainstem response (ABR) thresholds, reduced cochlear hair cell apoptosis, and alleviated oxidative damage. It inhibited ferroptosis by decreasing Fe(2) (+), ROS, MDA, and LPO levels, while upregulating SOD, GSH, GCL, and GPX4. Mechanistically, nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (NRF2) was identified as a key responsive target through target prediction and qPCR validation, while molecular docking and microscale thermophoresis (MST) assays demonstrated a direct interaction between Notoginsenoside R1 and SQSTM1 (p62). Besides, Notoginsenoside R1 enhanced p62 expression and promoted NRF2 nuclear translocation, restoring expression of GCLC, GCLM, and GPX4. Both p62 knockout and siRNA-mediated knockdown progressively attenuated these protective effects. These findings suggest that Notoginsenoside R1 protects against SSNHL by inhibiting ferroptosis and oxidative stress via activation of the p62-NRF2-GCL-GPX4 axis.
abstract_zh: 突发性感觉神经性听力损失（SSNHL）是一种常见的听觉疾病，其发病机制涉及氧化应激和铁死亡。三七皂苷R1（Notoginsenoside R1）是三七的主要成分，具有抗氧化和细胞保护作用，但其在铁死亡调控中的作用尚不清楚。本研究采用SSNHL小鼠模型和氧-葡萄糖剥夺/复氧（OGD/R）诱导的耳研究所-耳蜗毛细胞1（HEI-OC1）细胞模型，评估三七皂苷R1的作用。三七皂苷R1显著降低了听觉脑干反应（ABR）阈值，减少了耳蜗毛细胞凋亡，并缓解了氧化损伤。它通过降低Fe(2) (+)、ROS、MDA和LPO水平，同时上调SOD、GSH、GCL和GPX4，抑制了铁死亡。机制上，通过靶点预测和qPCR验证，核因子E2相关因子2（NRF2）被确定为关键响应靶点，而分子对接和微量热泳动（MST）实验表明三七皂苷R1与SQSTM1（p62）之间存在直接相互作用。此外，三七皂苷R1增强了p62表达并促进NRF2核转位，恢复了GCLC、GCLM和GPX4的表达。p62敲除和siRNA介导的敲低均逐渐减弱了这些保护效应。这些发现表明，三七皂苷R1通过激活p62-NRF2-GCL-GPX4轴抑制铁死亡和氧化应激，从而保护SSNHL。
